name: Computacenter plc
research_rationale: Q3 RNS strengthens earnings-quality case, but rich valuation and filing basic EPS decline support the screen hold on timing rather than adding aggressively.

weekly_updates.summary:
26 Oct Q3 RNS: Q3 ahead of expectations; FY26 adjusted PBT outlook raised to no less than £425m; committed backlog £12.6bn.  
Screen unchanged at hold (3w, neutral timing); P/E 25.5 and FCF yield still fail core cheapness gates despite filing-aligned FCF £257.6m.  
23 Oct interim RemCo chair appointment; no new audited accounts since 12 Oct memo.
